business.description: CyberTech Systems and Software Limited is an engineering company specialized in enterprise cloud, geospatial (Esri ArcGIS), and SAP transformation (S/4HANA, BTP). It provides managed services, cloud DevSecOps, and AI-enabled offerings.

outlook.statement: Secular trends driving business remain intact — modernization of mission-critical systems, convergence of geospatial and enterprise intelligence, cloud transformation, and rapid rise of AI across technology stack. Company will continue with focus, engineering depth, financial discipline, and selective investment.

While global macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainties may pose near-term challenges, CyberTech is well-positioned to navigate them. Our healthy cash reserves and long-standing customer relationships equip us to absorb short-term pressures and stay focused on long-term value creation.

With a debt-free balance sheet, a growing portfolio of cloud clients, and a disciplined management approach, we are well-positioned to build durable, long-term value for shareholders in the years ahead.

Actual results may differ materially from those expressed in the statement. Important factors that could influence the Company's operations include global and domestic demand and supply conditions of Information Technology related services, changes in government regulations, tax laws, economic developments within the country and other factors such as litigation and industrial relations.

The Management remains attentive to geopolitical and macroeconomic factors that may influence near-term business sentiment and investment cycles across certain industries. Despite these external headwinds, the Company is well-prepared to navigate such dynamics through its strong balance sheet, healthy cash reserves, resilient delivery models, and trusted customer relationships.
We enter our next decade with an AI-first operating approach embedded across our delivery and products.

While we maintain confidence in the long-term secular trends driving our business, we approach the near-term with caution, focusing on operational efficiency, selective investments, and maintaining our strong financial position to emerge stronger when market conditions stabilize.

CyberTech Inc. is well-positioned to capitalize on accelerating cloud adoption and the growing demand for AI-powered enterprise solutions. Pipeline in SAP S/4HANA transformations, expanding MACS engagements, and increasing enterprise focus on digital modernization provide a solid foundation for the periods ahead.

Spatialitics is well-positioned to address the accelerating demand for spatial analytics solutions across multiple industry verticals and will continue to invest in its products and go-to-market to build durable value over time.

Exchange differences arising out of these transactions are charged to the Statement of Profit and Loss.
